entities.name: 无服务器 (serverless)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Flash 目前主要锁定在无服务器端点上，任务跑在云端分配的 GPU 上；冷启动在所有无服务器平台上都很常见

evidence.quote: So currently, this is how you deploy a serverless application.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have serverless endpoints.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It's mostly locked on serverless right now, but we're working towards doing it for pods.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have warm caching in network volume attachments so that if you ever have to scale up with your serverless endpoints, then it has those caches carried over through the network volumes.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And then the most important part is the live serverless.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So it's provisioning this serverless endpoint.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This is common with all serverless platforms.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 端点 (endpoints)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Flash 支持无服务器端点、队列端点和负载均衡端点，并有一项端点到端点通信功能：执行函数看起来像在本地，部署到不同端点后底层自动互通

evidence.quote: We have serverless endpoints.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have queue endpoints for it and load balance endpoints that you can use it for.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But once you deploy it in different endpoints, it's all talking to each other.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have warm caching in network volume attachments so that if you ever have to scale up with your serverless endpoints, then it has those caches carried over through the network volumes.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And it just fans out, builds out all these endpoints, runs your training, and then reports back to you.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
